video.review: Contact sheet plus focused knife and MP5 swipe sequences; side swipes had missed the old two-sample downward detector.

changes: Turn-stick up/down selects CS grenades or Engineer deployable; A/X defaults to TF ability and jetpack, preserving CS magazine-release priority.
Knife follows native controller grip frame; CS grenade top follows thumb direction with mirrored palm-side lever.
MP5 handle rotates about cocking tube rather than floating upwards; swept palm detection accepts a larger approach volume and single fresh motion sample.
CS pistols have normal accuracy/recoil without unsupported long-gun multiplier.
Optional M3 auto offhand hold defaults on, persists in VR menu, transfers when support grip is retained and weapon grip is released.
DE validates one primary, one sidearm and knife across purchases, explicit Use pickups and round carryover; surplus carryover drops; drop pool capped at 64.

Cosmetic gunshot marks: one 128-instance MultiMesh, 32 pending, 4 candidates / 16 corner rays per frame, 30-second life, 40-metre distance cutoff, no physics interpolation, shadow or GI; shotgun impact RPCs batched.

live_test.unlimited_money: Test-only override restores $16000 after every purchase; live buy wheel available anywhere. Team purchase restrictions remain active.
live_test.bomb: Chest carried. Production planting switches solo tester to CT, supplies defusal tweezers and gives a 180-second test fuse.

limitations: Controller comfort/orientation and physical gesture tolerances require hands-on confirmation.
Decals omit surface edges and moving/breakable geometry. One draw-call overhead measured; VR GPU frame-time impact has not been benchmarked.
Existing third-party hand material UID fallbacks and test shutdown ObjectDB/resource warnings remain; no script/parse errors in passing runs.
All test-only overrides and desktop fovea mask live under export-excluded test-results.
